dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, I'm writing about childhood in Thailand and Canada. Where did you grow up?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪm ˈraɪtɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˈtʃaɪldhʊd ɪn ˈtaɪlænd ənd ˈkænədə. ˈwɛr dɪd juː ˈɡroʊ ˈʌp?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In Bangkok. But every April, I used to stay with my grandparents in the countryside.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk. bʌt ˈɛvri ˈeɪprəl, aɪ ˈjuːst tə ˈsteɪ wɪð maɪ ˈɡrænpɛrənts ɪn ðə ˈkʌntrisaɪd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In a small village by a river. I used to play by the river with my cousins.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ə ˈsmɔːl ˈvɪlɪdʒ baɪ ə ˈrɪvər. aɪ ˈjuːst tə ˈpleɪ baɪ ðə ˈrɪvər wɪð maɪ ˈkʌzənz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That sounds lovely! And in Bangkok?
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈsaʊndz ˈlʌvli! ənd ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I used to walk to kindergarten with my mom every morning.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈjuːst tə ˈwɔːk tə ˈkɪndərɡɑːrtən wɪð maɪ ˈmɑːm ˈɛvri ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I grew up in the countryside in Canada, near a small village. I used to walk to school in the snow!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈɡruː ˈʌp ɪn ðə ˈkʌntrisaɪd ɪn ˈkænədə, ˈnɪr ə ˈsmɔːl ˈvɪlɪdʒ. aɪ ˈjuːst tə ˈwɔːk tə ˈskuːl ɪn ðə ˈsnoʊ!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, but I loved it. We used to play outside all day.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt aɪ ˈlʌvd ɪt. wiː ˈjuːst tə ˈpleɪ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ˈɔːl ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Children in Bangkok don't play outside very much now.
dialogue.reading: ˈtʃɪldrən ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk ˈdoʊnt ˈpleɪ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ˈvɛri ˈmʌtʃ ˈnaʊ.
